name: marketplace
description: Modular backend package for the marketplace (juvo food-delivery PaaS) vertical
_comment: First frappe half of this module (dart-only before). Carries the tenant-side juvo seeder SCRIPTS extracted from control/control/seeds/scripts/ (RokctAI/control). They declare no hooks: seeders are invoked manually (bench execute) or by the tenant shell's installer, never wired into scheduler/doc_events. The ~380k-line Laravel-era juvo seed DUMPS (control/control/seeds/*.json) deliberately REMAIN in the control repo untouched, pending Ray's archive/delete decision - the scripts here do not read them. The empty control block declares control-persona presence so persona stripping composes correctly (fleet convention).
